scientific_question: Can the confirmed natural image-space object-footprint signal be compressed into a small, stable, natural-image-recoverable per-image state that is worth predicting in a future spatial World Model?

frozen_upstream.transitive_ledger: The upstream restart transitively preserves C0-v2, C1-v2.1 candidate identities and production scale, D13/D14/D15, WM-v2A/B/B.1/C-EJ, the camera contract, and all prior mechanism verdicts.

calibration.use: all target-form, rank, resolution, decoder, threshold, normalization, ridge, and residual calibration

development_evaluation.use: one-shot frozen development evaluation, not blind confirmation

per_image_contract.rule: Every target is S(I_t) from one unmodified natural future image; candidate-pair differences are evaluation operations only.
per_image_contract.global: frozen natural-image CLIP ViT-B/32 L2-normalized global projection [512]
per_image_contract.patch: frozen natural-image CLIP ViT-B/32 49 post-layernorm projected and per-token-normalized features [49,512]
per_image_contract.teacher: native relevant-object segmentation is an offline training/diagnostic teacher and never a deployment input

candidate_definitions.D0: T0 frozen global CLIP only; immutable baseline
candidate_definitions.D1: T2 calibration-selected low-dimensional generic spatial map only
candidate_definitions.D2: T3 calibration-selected low-resolution object occupancy plus visible area; oracle teacher target
candidate_definitions.D3: T4 natural-image proxy occupancy plus area, without global CLIP
candidate_definitions.D4: T5 global CLIP plus the same natural-image proxy
candidate_definitions.D5: T6 global CLIP plus direct object-footprint auxiliary target; teacher labels are training-only

t1_reference.role: upper-information reference only; cannot be mechanically selected

t2_generic.selection: maximize the worse leave-one-init-out G+map improvement over G across ObjMask and Area; candidates within one percentage point choose the smaller per-image dimension

footprint.occupancy: union relevant-object pixel fraction inside fixed floor-linspace image cells
footprint.visible_area: exact union relevant-object visible fraction in the 128x128 natural image
footprint.selection: resolution must clear the calibration 10-percent oracle increment when possible; among allowed forms select the lowest proxy CV loss with the preregistered size/width tie rules

t4_proxy.architecture: shared task-agnostic per-patch Linear(512,h)-GELU-Linear(h,1), or h=0 linear ablation, plus a pooled patch area head
t4_proxy.selection: minimize leave-one-init-out normalized occupancy-MSE plus area-MAE; forms within 1 percent choose fewer output cells then smaller hidden width; choose threshold by OOF IoU, balanced-accuracy tie-break, then lower threshold

pair_summaries.probe_role: fixed low-capacity comparison feature, not the stored per-image target

distance_contract.footprint_and_proxy: RMSE after concatenating occupancy cells and the area scalar
distance_contract.hybrid: root-mean-square of global and spatial distances after separate calibration ordinary-temporal normalization
distance_contract.ordinary_motion: within the same real candidate branch, adjacent h1-h8 future images; 40 branches x 3 candidates x 7 transitions
distance_contract.scale_control: ratio of mean candidate-pair distance to mean ordinary temporal distance

probes.selection: leave-one-init-state-out CV within init31-34; exact tie favors larger alpha
targets: ObjMask residual after calibration EE-only fit
Area residual after calibration EE-only fit

shuffle.rule: derange the entire new six-dimensional spatial summary across branch points within identical task, horizon, and candidate pair while keeping global and target fixed

bootstrap.unit: task-stratified matched branch point retaining all 24 pair/horizon rows

gates.shuffle_rule: relative degradation positive with branch-bootstrap CI lower above zero
gates.design_pass: at least one ObjMask/Area primary pass, at least one 5-percent residual pass, spatial shuffle, scale-controlled separation, 7/10 tasks, 4/8 horizons, all pairs, reasonable dimension, and deployment compatibility
gates.deployment_rule: D2/D5 are oracle teacher designs and cannot alone authorize GO; D3/D4 additionally require the frozen natural-recovery gate

decision.go_scope: seed11 single-model small spatial World Model prototype only

candidate_headroom_reference.gate_role: discussion only; does not alter target-design gates

preflight_correction_history.stop: CuBLAS deterministic execution required CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG before the first decoder forward pass
preflight_correction_history.correction: set CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=:4096:8 for the unchanged deterministic run

preflight_correction_history.stop: CUDA adaptive_avg_pool2d backward has no deterministic implementation for the preregistered 7-to-4 decoder path
preflight_correction_history.correction: replace only the 7-to-4 area-pooling implementation with its exact fixed separable overlap matrix

Do not change candidates, production scale, reranker, scoring rule, actor, or controller.
Do not run C1/C2, D20-v2, controller rollout, reward, done, success, or final task outcome.
Do not access init40-49 or run seed23/47.
Do not reopen EE/joint, context-conditioned physical, object-state physical, contact-adapter, or global-CLIP-delta routes.
Do not use simulator segmentation, object IDs, future state, reward, or success as T4 input or as a deployment input.
Do not add candidates beyond D0-D5 or choose formulas, ranks, resolution, widths, thresholds, normalization, or gates from init36-39.
Do not overwrite any upstream config, result, report, checkpoint, or sidecar.
